OBJECT Codeunit 50020 Call Parens
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=21.11.26;
    Time=12:00:00;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=TEST;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
  }
  CODE
  {
    PROCEDURE RunCalls@1();
    VAR
      ItemLedgEntryL@1000 : Record 32;
      WorkDateL@1001 : Date;
      CompanyL@1002 : Text[50];
    BEGIN
      // CAL020: zero-arg calls including TODAY() and COMPANYNAME() get ()
      WorkDateL := TODAY();
      CompanyL := COMPANYNAME();
      DoInternal();
      ItemLedgEntryL.RESET();
      IF ItemLedgEntryL.ISEMPTY() THEN
        // CAL020: EXIT must NOT have empty parens
        EXIT;
      IF ItemLedgEntryL.FINDSET() THEN
        REPEAT
          MESSAGE('%1 %2', WorkDateL, CompanyL);
        UNTIL ItemLedgEntryL.NEXT() = 0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE DoInternal@2() Result : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      // CAL020: EXIT with return value keeps parens
      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }
}
